none: PAS NLM-4C0382: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy Coin. Nummus of House of Constantine, probably a copy of a fallen horseman issue of 355-361, Reece period 18. Obverse description: Bust diademed right, large eye. Reverse description: Soldier advancing left spearing fallen horseman; the horseman is pitched head first to lower left. Reverse inscription: : [FEL TEMP REPARATIO]. Diameter: 9.6mm, Weight: 0.69gms, die axis: 12
